title: FR-40 arm C measures the conventions packet against the instruction file alone
body:
Why: memory audit: FR-40 compared packet vs none and vs static standards, never vs the repository instruction file alone, which already carries most rules (lanes arm A 75%).
Outcome: arm C (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md only) on the 133 lane units; keep the packet only if B - C is significant.
Proof: evals/fr40 report prints B - C with n and p.
Scope: evals/fr40/.
Amendment A2 (fable-plan 2.3): becomes the standards measurement (fable-plan section 3.5): generated outside fixture, arms A/B/C/D, three held-out standards, stratum-level rule; after t-8vk9p13.
